title: Photo QA result
description: One result per candidate, written by the reviewer to the queue entry's resultPath. scripts/photo/lib/qa.mjs (validateQaResult) enforces this schema and the verdict rules of qa-rubric.md.

candidate.description: Candidate name: kind and seed offset.

reviewer.description: Who looked: a person or an agent name.

score.description: Ranks passing candidates; a failing candidate scores 4 or less.

alt.description: Alt text written from the image. Required and non-empty when the verdict is pass; the manifest check applies its rules to it.

reasons.description: One short phrase per failure; empty on a pass.

amberObjects.description: Must be exactly 1 for a pass.

facesVisible.description: Any face or any head, even turned away or blurred.

impliedIdentity.description: The scene casts anyone as a founder, staff member, client, mentor, investor or testimonial.

widths.description: One entry for every srcset width below the master, narrowest first, plus the master.

note.description: One sentence saying what was seen, for a pass as well as a fail.
